containers.name: verify-migration
command:
import sqlite3,json,pathlib,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path('/data/archives/ASTRA-pre-0055-20260906')
original=sqlite3.connect("file:"+str(root/"pharness.db")+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
changed=sqlite3.connect("file:/data/pharness.db?mode=ro",uri=True)
assert "sha256:"+hashlib.sha256((root/"pharness.db").read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='sha256:a9d174c3201b68a355adfa6b4d33775469da00a921bf330a557983ced6565a5a'
changed.execute("ATTACH DATABASE ? AS archived", ("file:"+str(root/"pharness.db")+"?mode=ro",))
changed.execute("BEGIN")
assert changed.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]=="ok"
assert changed.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall()==[]
versions=changed.execute("SELECT version,success FROM _sqlx_migrations ORDER BY version").fetchall()
assert len(versions)==55 and versions[-1]==(55,1) and all(v[1]==1 for v in versions)
def quote(s): return '"'+s.replace('"','""')+'"'
def default(v):
 if isinstance(v,bytes): return {"sqlite_blob_hex":v.hex()}
 raise TypeError(type(v).__name__)
def fingerprint(db,table,columns,where=""):
 h=hashlib.sha256(); n=0
 sql="SELECT "+",".join(map(quote,columns))+" FROM "+quote(table)+where+" ORDER BY "+",".join(map(quote,columns))
 for row in db.execute(sql):
  h.update((json.dumps(list(row),sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False,default=default)+"\n").encode()); n+=1
 return {"columns":columns,"rows":n,"sha256":h.hexdigest()}
preserved={}
differences={}
tables=[r[0] for r in original.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name")]
for table in tables:
 columns=[r[1] for r in original.execute("PRAGMA table_info("+quote(table)+")")]
 before=fingerprint(original,table,columns)
 after=fingerprint(changed,table,columns," WHERE version <= 54" if table=="_sqlx_migrations" else "")
 if before!=after:
  schema=original.execute("PRAGMA table_info("+quote(table)+")").fetchall()
  keys=[r[1] for r in sorted(schema,key=lambda r:r[5]) if r[5]]
  detail={"before":before,"after":after,"primary_key_columns":keys}
  if keys:
   join=" AND ".join("a."+quote(key)+" IS b."+quote(key) for key in keys)
   qualified=quote(table)
   detail["deleted_original_rows"]=changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM archived."+qualified+" a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main."+qualified+" b WHERE "+join+")").fetchone()[0]
   detail["added_rows"]=changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM main."+qualified+" b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived."+qualified+" a WHERE "+join+")").fetchone()[0]
   detail["modified_columns"]={}
   for column in columns:
    count=changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM archived."+qualified+" a JOIN main."+qualified+" b ON "+join+" WHERE a."+quote(column)+" IS NOT b."+quote(column)).fetchone()[0]
    if count:detail["modified_columns"][column]=count
  differences[table]=detail
 preserved[table]=after
# A running API updates liveness and bootstrap timestamps. Inspect every difference,
# preserve all original identities/history, and permit only the source-proven fields.
import time
now_ms=int(time.time()*1000)
allowed={"agent_hosts":{"last_contact_at","updated_at"},"organizations":{"updated_at"}}
print(json.dumps({"check":"difference_inventory","differences":differences}),flush=True)
assert set(differences)<=set(allowed)|{"agent_host_capability_snapshots"},("unexpected_table_changes",list(differences))
retained_history={}
for table,detail in differences.items():
 assert detail["deleted_original_rows"]==0,("deleted_original_rows",table)
 if table=="agent_host_capability_snapshots":
  assert detail["modified_columns"]=={},"existing capability history changed"
  columns=detail["before"]["columns"]
  retained=fingerprint(changed,table,columns,' WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM archived.agent_host_capability_snapshots)')
  assert retained==detail["before"],"original capability history fingerprint changed"
  retained_history[table]=retained
  newest_old=int(original.execute("SELECT max(CAST(created_at AS INTEGER)) FROM agent_host_capability_snapshots").fetchone()[0])
  additions=changed.execute("SELECT created_at,expires_at,host_id FROM agent_host_capability_snapshots WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM archived.agent_host_capability_snapshots)")
  existing_hosts={r[0] for r in original.execute("SELECT id FROM agent_hosts")}
  for created,expires,host in additions:
   assert newest_old<=int(created)<=now_ms and int(expires)>int(created) and host in existing_hosts,"unexpected added host snapshot"
 else:
  assert detail["added_rows"]==0 and set(detail["modified_columns"])<=allowed[table],("unexpected_mutable_fields",table)
  columns=[column for column in detail["before"]["columns"] if column not in allowed[table]]
  old_history=fingerprint(original,table,columns);new_history=fingerprint(changed,table,columns)
  assert old_history==new_history,("stable_record_changed",table)
  retained_history[table]=new_history
  for column in detail["modified_columns"]:
   rows=changed.execute("SELECT a."+quote(column)+",b."+quote(column)+" FROM archived."+quote(table)+" a JOIN main."+quote(table)+" b ON a.id=b.id")
   for old,new in rows:assert int(old)<=int(new)<=now_ms,("nonmonotonic_operational_time",table,column)

assert original.execute("SELECT max(version) FROM _sqlx_migrations").fetchone()[0]==54
scopes=[json.loads(r[0]) for r in changed.execute("SELECT scope_json FROM inference_evaluations")]
assert all(scope=={"kind":"full_qualification"} for scope in scopes),"Unexpected diagnostic write before release preservation gate"
assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM work_items WHERE workflow_policy_json IS NOT NULL OR workflow_policy_hash IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]==0
for table in ['hosted_reconciliations','hosted_operations','hosted_operation_locks']:
 assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM "+table).fetchone()[0]==0
assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM deployment_intents WHERE delivery_stage != 'legacy'").fetchone()[0]==0
assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM gitops_change_sets g JOIN deployment_intents d ON d.id=g.deployment_intent_id WHERE d.delivery_stage != 'legacy'").fetchone()[0]==0
print(json.dumps({"schema_version":"pharness.dev/live-copy-migration-evidence/v1alpha1","integrity":"ok","foreign_key_violations":0,"maximum_migration":55,"applied_migrations":len(versions),"source_migration_unchanged":original.execute("SELECT max(version) FROM _sqlx_migrations").fetchone()[0],"archive_sha256":'sha256:a9d174c3201b68a355adfa6b4d33775469da00a921bf330a557983ced6565a5a',"all_original_columns_identical":not differences,"differences":differences,"preservation_check":"passed","all_original_rows_present":True,"all_application_and_audit_rows_identical":True,"retained_history_fingerprints":retained_history,"operational_timestamp_allowlist":{k:sorted(v) for k,v in allowed.items()},"added_history_policy":"Only capability snapshots for already enrolled hosts, preserving every original snapshot and using later valid timestamps","historical_evaluations_full_scope":len(scopes),"diagnostic_evaluations":0,"preserved_tables":len(preserved),"original_column_fingerprints":preserved,"hosted_rows":0,"runtime_image":'registry.lucas.engineering/pharness-runtime@sha256:270abac12bdf9505b042855b5a7abb1369562e8087382eaec537822332b0b2db',"source_revision":'92f8f1b8e98dd45d0a01e030aeb99ef9bcf95267',"scope":"read-only live schema-55 verification before diagnostics"}))
